source_order: For each issuer and year inspect the group's original full English consolidated annual/financial report in native HTML where available. A report split across official HTML pages is searched in financial/report TOC order; select entire standalone financial section page containing the first qualifying table and preserve its full source, context, financial year, edition and page URL. Where the full annual report is PDF-only/unavailable in native HTML or contains no qualifying table, inspect original completed full-year results announcement in native HTML as issued by that company, then its original January-to-September results announcement in native HTML if available. Allow issuer website or original regulator/exchange/dissemination-service RNS announcement, including the complete as-distributed HTML carried by a named authorized RNS distributor when source identified by original release date, sender, announcement ID and/or issue number. No editorial articles, transcripts, websites paraphrasing company statements, PDF conversion, mirrored HTML with unsourced provenance or renaming of PDFs. Document what was checked. Only one family in this conditional stratum can contribute each slot and previously examined corporate families ineligible, as in main registration.
